content_sections.heading: GGSGH Junior Resident Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the GGSGH Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download GGSGH Junior Resident Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Junior Resident (MBBS): MBBS Degree with marks sheets and attempt certificate; internship completed on or after 11.08.2024; valid DMC certificate or acknowledgement slip.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum age limit for all posts is 30 years. Age relaxation is admissible as per Govt. of India Rules for persons with disability.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for GGSGH Junior Resident Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Guru Gobind Singh Government Hospital (GGSGH) in New Delhi, a government healthcare institution.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment drive is Junior Resident (MBBS), offering medical professionals an opportunity.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for Junior Resident posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 12 vacancies available for the Junior Resident (MBBS) posts at GGSGH, providing multiple opportunities.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for GGSGH Junior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is a Walk-in Interview, meaning candidates need to attend in person with their documents.

faq.question: Q5. What is the walk-in interview date for Junior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Junior Resident posts is scheduled for 11 August 2026. Candidates should report on this date.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for Junior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Junior Resident posts is 30 years, with relaxations as per government rules.

faq.question: Q7. What are the essential qualifications required for Junior Resident?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS Degree, have completed their internship on or after 11.08.2024, and hold a valid DMC certificate.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for GGSGH Junior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the GGSGH Junior Resident recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for Junior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification to assess the eligibility and suitability of candidates.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview location for GGSGH Junior Resident?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the Guru Gobind Singh Government Hospital (GGSGH) office in New Delhi, Delhi (Pincode: 110027).
